cover.coreProposition: Waiting should be represented as durable runtime state with explicit condition, observation, admission and effect-evidence boundaries, rather than as repeated free-form agent turns.
cover.visualMetaphor: A quiet sentinel tower holding position while one distant signal crosses a luminous threshold line
cover.semanticObject: One stationary watchpoint and one externally arriving signal, emphasizing readiness without constant motion
cover.compositionIntent: Serious landscape editorial cover with a dark calm field, a single watchpoint on one side, one bright external signal approaching from the other, and enough negative space to read at thumbnail scale
